what_happened.line: The Select Board voted to authorize the chair to sign the revised project scope and budget amendment with the Mass School Building Authority for the new middle/high school.
The board voted to accept the town manager's recommendation and appoint a member to the Agricultural Commission.
The board limited the July 8 joint session with the planning board to one topic, stormwater, because it will have action items.
A workshop was set for 6:00 on July 1 on the boot drive, financial policies and possibly IT director policies.
The board went into executive session on a lawsuit by roll call and did not return to open session.

why_it_matters: The scope and budget agreement with the state building authority sets what the new middle/high school project can claim for reimbursement, which affects how much of its cost falls on local taxpayers.

A member asked for the maintenance plan and projected costs of the underground stormwater retention at the new school, and for whether off-site signage is reimbursable, so some operating and project costs may land on the town budget, mostly taxes.
watch_next: July 1 workshop at 6:00 and July 8 joint session with the planning board on stormwater.
Next meeting: the board is to compile town manager goals and its own goals for discussion.
